image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a silver alloy car wheel mounted with a black rubber tire. The wheel features a multi-spoke design (approximately 15-20 thin spokes) radiating from a central hub. The center cap is distinctively yellow and green with text, contrasting with the silver rim. The tire shows partial white lettering on the sidewall. The background is blurred, suggesting shallow depth of field.
